lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Aurelion Sol's damaging abilities against enemies grant him stacks of Stardust, which improve each of his abilities. The amount of Stardust collected by each ability may vary by target.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Breath of Light}}: Bursts deal bonus magic damage equal to (0.031% Stardust stacks) of the target's maximum health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Astral Flight}}: Range is increased by 7.5 units per Stardust.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Singularity}}: Outer and inner radius increased by 15% Stardust stacks, and execution threshold increased by 2.6% Stardust stacks.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Falling Star}} and The Skies Descend}}: Effect radius increased by 15% Stardust stacks.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Aurelion Sol channel for up to 3.25 seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit, standard sight them, and deals them 3.75–11.25 (+ 1.875–6.875) (+ 7.5% AP) magic damage every 0.125 seconds, reduced to 50% for other surrounding enemies hit by the beam.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Breath of Light can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: For each second that the beam continuously damages the same enemy, it bursts to deal 20–40 (+ 40–80) (+ 50% AP) (+ and grants 1 Stardust if the target is a champion. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Aurelion Sol ends Breath of Light early.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: At rank 5, Breath of Light's channel duration lasts for as long as Aurelion Sol can pay its mana cost.
